component_height: float
height of the component in inches
component_width: float

component_floor_clearance: float
floor clearance of the component in inches
panel_inline_front: indicates whether the panel’s front or right edge aligns with an in-line stile rather than a wall or perpendicular stile
panel_front_stile_floor_to_ceiling: if the panel’s front or right edge abuts an inline stile, indicates whether the inline stile is floor-to-ceiling (XX86) or not
panel_inline_back: indicates whether the panel’s back or left edge aligns with an in-line stile rather than a wall or perpendicular stile
panel_back_stile_floor_to_ceiling: if the panel’s back or right edge abuts an inline stile, indicates whether the inline stile is floor-to-ceiling (XX86) or not
stile_in_the_back: indicates whether the stile is in the back of the panel
floor_to_ceiling: bool
indicates whether the stall is floor to ceiling or not
component_ceiling_clearance: float
ceiling clearance of the component in inches
stile_in_back_width: width of the stile in the back of the panel in inches
panel_section: Whether the panel is not split, or, if split horizontally with an h-channel, defines whether this is the top or bottom piece
